a.lede: The Remus infostealer is stealing Gmail messages through a stealthy malicious Chrome extension, a capability the malware operators marketed as a zero-day exploit in Google's email service. [...]
a.title: Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension

b.lede: A new version of the SYS01 infostealer malware delivered through Meta ads is enrolling browsers into enterprise-style management to force the installation of an extension that steals sensitive data, including Gmail and Outlook emails. [...]
b.title: SYS010 malware abuses browser management to spy on Gmail, Outlook
